# lila

Lila scripting API.

```
import lila
loc = lila.locator("Target")          # object API (lila.nodes)
loc.translate_y = 10
lila.ops.parent("Target", "Rig")     # every command, also as bare names in the script editor
```

## Progress

```python
Progress(title: str, total: float = 0.0, cancellable: bool = False) -> None
```

Progress of a long script, shown like a scene load: with lila.Progress("Baking", total=n) as p: p.step()

### Progress.step

```python
step(n: float = 1.0) -> None
```

Advance by n units.

### Progress.set_status

```python
set_status(text: str) -> None
```

### Progress.cancelled

```python
cancelled: bool
```

Read only.

True once the user pressed Cancel.

## undo_chunk

```python
undo_chunk(name='chunk')
```

Groups every edit made inside into one undo step. Chunks nest; only the outermost becomes a step.

```
with lila.undo_chunk("Build arm"):

...
```

@lila.undo_chunk("Build arm") def build_arm(): ...
